intro: We built Upmods Eudora to hold what your wardrobe can’t. Eudora’s deep underbed storage and wide headboard make it easier to rest well — and organising — beautifully simple.

features.title: Dependable by design
features.text: Made from high-quality engineered wood, our bed delivers lasting support and timeless design — because we believe your furniture should grow with you.

features.title: A headboard that offers both support and style
features.text: The wide rectangular headboard adds a modern touch while giving you a comfy spot to lean back — whether you're reading, relaxing or enjoying a quiet morning.

features.title: Hydraulic storage made easy
features.text: The smooth gas-lift system gives you quick, effortless access to generous underbed storage — perfect for keeping your space calm, clear and clutter-free. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: A warm, grounded look for your home
features.text: Our cinnamon laminate finish wraps your room in natural warmth — creating a space that feels restful, cosy, and beautifully balanced.

features.title: A finish that stands up to life
features.text: Protected with a PU coating, your bed stays safe from everyday nicks and scratches — keeping its clean, polished look with minimal effort.

name: Upmods Eudora Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
